title: Positive exactness of the free module presheaf nerve
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category, $R$ a presheaf of rings and $f:P\to Q$ a map of set presheaves. All values lie in the same universe $v$. Let $K_n=R[N_n(f)]$ be the free module presheaf on the $(n+1)$-fold presheaf fibre product, with alternating deletion boundary [def-weil-pbc-free-module, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification, def-sc-presheaf-cech-complex]. Then $K$ is exact at $n+1$ for every natural number $n$. No surjectivity of $f$ is assumed.
